Th e NKF K/DOQI guidelines on nutrition have established
a general recommendation of 1.2 grams of protein/kg body 
weight for HD patients to ensure adequate intake of essential 
amino acids. At least 50% of the protein should be of high
biological value. Th ese recommendations are based on the level
of protein intake that will maintain neutral or positive nitrogen
balance and lead to an improvement or maintenance of visceral
protein stores for the majority of HD patients.23

Meal planning can be a challenge for patients with CKD. Em-
phasizing the use of usual foods and recipes with modiﬁ cations 
to meet nutrient needs allows for an individualized approach
(see Box 18.4). Table 18.5 provides an example of a two-day 
menu for a patient with Stage 3 CKD.
